messages:
Maya: quick sync — embeddings throughput degraded for EU customers, product wants staged customer messaging. Need statuspage copy + 1-line email + short in-app banner. aiming to publish initial note ~10:30 PT. @Priya can you check tone? @Diego CS which customer tiers get email?

Jon Ops: how long is the window? ETA on fix?

Ava Eng: patch is rolling, partial recovery expected in ~45m, full recovery target 2h. fallback plan is rollback to prior model if degradation persists. no indicators of data exposure. will post update when we hit 50% throughput back.

Priya: high-level approach: 3-stage comms (Investigating → Update → Mitigated) with consistent CTA to /status and support links. tone: calm, technical enough for eng teams, reassurance for product owners. below are draft snippets (feel free to shorten).

Maya: please paste drafts and we can iterate.

Priya: Draft A — Statuspage (Investigating)
```
Title: Degraded embeddings throughput in EU region — investigating
Status: Investigating
What we’re seeing: Some customers in EU are experiencing reduced embeddings throughput and increased latency for batch jobs.
Impact: Lower throughput for embeddings API calls; generation/embedding requests may be delayed.
What we’re doing: Engineers are investigating and rolling a targeted patch to affected hosts.
Customer guidance: No data has been exposed. If you rely on scheduled batch jobs, consider postponing until we post an update.
ETA: We expect partial recovery within ~45 minutes; we will provide an update within 30 minutes.
Link: https://status.redwood.ai
```

Priya: Draft B — Email to Enterprise/Dedicated customers (short)
```
Subject: Temporary embeddings throughput degradation in EU — we’re on it
Hi — we’re investigating an intermittent throughput drop affecting embeddings in our EU region. Our engineers are deploying a fix now and we expect partial recovery in ~45 minutes. No customer data was exposed. We’ll send another update when the issue is mitigated. If this impacts production SLAs, reply and we’ll fast-track support.
```

Priya: Draft C — In-product banner (1-liner)
```
Embeddings throughput in EU is degraded — our team is investigating. See status.redwood.ai for updates.
```

Diego CS: add explicit "no customer data was exposed" in all outward-facing copy and call out enterprise email for Dedicated/Private customers. Also want a short FAQ line for customers who ask about job reruns.

Maya: agreed. plan: publish Investigating update to status page at 10:30 PT, push in-app banner at same time, send targeted enterprise email at 10:40 PT. Social: quick note on X linking to status page at 10:35 PT.

Jon Ops: who publishes to status?

Maya: I’ll publish the initial Investigating post. @Priya you sign off on the Update -> Mitigated copy. @Ava Eng will drop a quick tech update when we hit partial recovery and when rollout completes.

Ava Eng: noted. I’ll post a short engineering update with root-cause if rollback required.

StatusBot: Draft status entry queued to staging (ID: stg-9876). Review link: https://status.redwood.ai/staging/stg-9876

Maya: final Q — any objection to the wording below for the enterprise email subject line?
Diego CS: none from CS, want to prep support snippets for common asks (rerun guidance + impact windows).

Priya: minor tweak — change "intermittent" → "temporary" in subject line. otherwise +1.

Maya: updated and will post at 10:30 PT. Team, please stand by for the 10:45 PT check-in to confirm mitigation and any follow-ups. :white_check_mark: :loudspeaker:

Diego CS: prepping targeted support KB and canned responses now.

Jon Ops: will monitor infra dashboards and flag if rollout breaches 2h window.

Ava Eng: will ping here when throughput hits 50% recovered.

Maya: thanks everyone — will DM the list of enterprise recipients for the 10:40 PT email.

StatusBot: Update published to staging at 2105021245.
